# Flowstate

> An open-source, minimalist productivity web application designed to help users maintain deep focus and optimize daily workflows. Operating in Production Status in preparation for live presentation on September 10th.

## Key Features
- **Flow-inducing Workspace:** Minimal distraction, clean interface.
- **Task Management:** Organizes daily schedules and execution steps seamlessly.
- **Automated Routines:** Email focus check-ins and structured habit loops.

## Technical Stack
- Framework: Next.js
- Database & Auth: Supabase (Supabase Pro plan)
- Deployment: Coolify on VPS (Fully off Vercel)
- Codebase: Open-source
